platform: KBOO 90.7 FM Official Genre-Directed Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KBOO does not maintain a digital music library and says it cannot download or burn CDs from digital submissions. Physical music must be addressed to the appropriate genre contact, including dedicated routes for electronic, rock, hip-hop, jazz, folk, world music and reggae. All submissions become KBOO property, are not returned and carry no airplay guarantee. A human must choose the correct genre recipient, approve the non-return/property terms, prepare compliant physical media and mail the package manually.

platform: KZSU 90.1 FM Official Music Director Email and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KZSU publicly lists music@kzsu.stanford.edu for Music Directors and provides USPS and UPS delivery addresses. Its detailed music-submission link is protected by temporary-cookie/browser-verification controls and the crawler could not retrieve the live workflow. KZSU also asks correspondents to use no more than three addresses and ideally one. A human must open the authorized route in a normal browser, handle any verification without automation, inspect the current requirements, select one appropriate delivery channel and submit manually.

platform: KZSC 88.1 FM Official Music Submission Form and Genre Director Physical Route
manual_review_reason: KZSC's official contact form includes a Music Submission category and routes messages to the Station Manager. The form contains a hidden phone field that must remain unchanged, so it is an anti-spam boundary and must not be automated. KZSC also publishes USPS and UPS physical addresses and lists genre-specific Music Directors, but their email links are protected and were not decoded. A human must select the appropriate route, inspect the live form, leave anti-spam controls untouched and submit or mail the release manually.

platform: KCSB 91.9 FM Official Music Director Email and Physical Demo Route
manual_review_reason: KCSB's official contact page invites new releases and demos in all formats, publishes int.md@kcsb.org for music inquiries and provides separate USPS and UPS/FedEx delivery addresses. The page does not publish complete digital attachment, link, metadata or file-size rules. A human must confirm the preferred delivery format with the Music Director when necessary, prepare a concise compliant release package and send the email or physical media manually.

platform: KDVS 90.3 FM Official Physical-Only New Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KDVS publicly lists musicdept@kdvs.org for its Music Directors but explicitly instructs senders to route all new music to the station mailing address as physical submissions only. The email must not be treated as a digital music-delivery workaround. Because the current contact page does not display the mailing address in the same section, a human must confirm the authoritative postal destination and accepted physical format directly from KDVS before preparing and mailing the package.
